title: Enhancing LLM-based Hatred and Toxicity Detection with Meta-Toxic Knowledge Graph

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) and classification metrics (Accuracy, F1, AUC) on hate speech benchmark datasets (e.g., HateXplain, IHC) to measure and mitigate LLM over-sensitivity to racial identity terms and racial ideologies.

Assessing toxicity detection performance using a meta-toxic knowledge graph to correctly identify implicit hate and reduce false positive misjudgments when processing text mentioning religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Jews, Christians).

Measuring the reduction in false positive toxicity classifications when evaluating texts containing gender-related terms (e.g., feminist) by providing the LLM with context from a domain-specific knowledge graph.
Analyzing the model's ability to accurately classify text targeting immigrants or specific nationalities without triggering excessive sensitivity to the identity terms themselves.
